regimens.dose_text: 10 mg/kg IV infusion over approximately 1 hour every 2 weeks. Confirm presence of amyloid-beta pathology prior to initiation. Mandatory brain MRI monitoring protocol: baseline MRI within 1 year; safety monitoring MRIs prior to the 5th (Week 9), 7th (Week 13), and 14th (Week 27) infusions. ApoE epsilon 4 genotyping strongly recommended prior to initiation due to substantially higher ARIA risk in homozygotes.
